Jared Bloom: Quick sync 1 we got a Marketplace intake for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need a minimal bundle: SKU CSV, short descriptions, AMI/GCR images, and the legal attachments. Target publish next Wed.
Evelyn Park: Product can own SKU CSV + short descriptions. Proposal: standard-hourly (preview), standard-monthly, dedicated-monthly(commit), support-addon. Keep names concise for ingestion.
Sofia Gomez: Legal here 1 I'll prepare a short EULA excerpt and export-control statement. Also need to confirm whether we must include a data processing addendum link for EU offers.
Ryota Tanaka: Infra note 1 AMIs are almost ready; final baking tomorrow. We can also push GCR images for GCP and a container registry image for Azure. Need the exact filenames to include in the bundle.
Jared Bloom: Great. Evelyn, can you paste the sample CSV format we should use?
Evelyn Park: Sample: 
```
sku_id,display_name,plan,pricing_unit,regions,notes
RDW_STD_M,Redwood Standard,monthly,per-token,global,GA
RDW_STD_H,Redwood Standard,preview-hourly,per-token,global,preview
RDW_DED_M,Redwood Dedicated,monthly,per-gpu,us-east-1;eu-west-1,requires-sales-contact
```
Sofia Gomez: Please tag features that persist customer data (e.g., KV cache persistence) so legal can call out residency in the listing.
Ryota Tanaka: Noted. We will produce two AMI families: public-std-ami-202406 and account-locked-ded-ami-202406. Will upload manifests to gs:// and s3://.
marketplace-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-marketplace/assets/onsite_bundle_202406.tar.gz (sha256: ff12a7...)
LegalBot: Reminder 1 Azure requires billing cadence explicitly in the offer docs and may need localized short descriptions for EU markets. Prepare EN/FR/DE strings.
Evelyn Park: Localization ok 1 marketing can supply EN/FR/DE short lines by Tuesday. I'll stub placeholders in the CSV for now.
Jared Bloom: Action list: 1) Product (Evelyn) publish SKU CSV + short desc (tomorrow), 2) Infra (Ryota) upload AMIs/images (tomorrow EOD), 3) Legal (Sofia) EULA + DPA pointer (48h), 4) Marketing to localize short descriptions. Reconvene in 24h if any blockers.
Sofia Gomez: I'll also prepare a one-page cover letter summarizing differences across clouds so the Marketplace PM can route approvals faster.
Jared Bloom: Thanks all. If infra hits any packaging issues ping #eng-infra. :thumbsup:
